toolsPreview.name: list_tools
toolsPreview.description: List all available Harvey Budget tools with pricing and input requirements. Use this for discovery.

toolsPreview.name: health
toolsPreview.description: Check Harvey Budget server status, uptime, and payment network configuration.

toolsPreview.name: register_agent
toolsPreview.description: Register an agent with daily and weekly budget limits. Free tool - call this before using check_spend or report_spend. Upserts if agent already exists.

toolsPreview.name: check_spend
toolsPreview.description: Pre-spend budget approval check. Verifies daily/weekly/category limits, estimates ROI from historical data, and suggests cheaper alternatives. Call this BEFORE paying for any service.

toolsPreview.name: report_spend
toolsPreview.description: Record a completed spend with optional outcome tracking. Call this AFTER paying for a service to track spending and build ROI history.

toolsPreview.name: get_spending_report
toolsPreview.description: Detailed spending analytics report. Returns total spent, category breakdown, top services with ROI, and optimization recommendations. Use to understand spending patterns and find inefficiencies.
